QuestInfo.name: [Andersen's Box] Despicable Dog Days!
QuestInfo.0:
Dog days of summer is here.
Various restaurants are handing out food discounts for this occasion. A restaurant called Chicken Bumps, well known for their Chicken Soup is #boffering discount coupons for their Chicken Soup every time the Andersen's Box is used.#K

Von Bon hearing about this became extremely angry and left the Maple World. Go listen to what Bon Von has to say.

#rCaution! This event can only be carried out once per account and the event cannot be started again once forfeited.#k
QuestInfo.1:
Von Bon is tired of all the chicken getting slaughtered for soup. Don't ask him why but he needs #b30 Chicken Soup Coupons#k.

Speak with Von Bon after you collected the 30 Chicken Soup Coupon.
(Speak with Von Bon by using the Event Notifier after collecting 30 Chicken Soup Coupons.#k)
QuestInfo.2: You have finished your conversation with Von Bon who was upset over the dog days.
